stem: A "negative autopsy" is one in which
options: The autopsy was refused by relatives
No cause of death is found even after full dissection, histology and toxicology
explanation: It accounts for a small percentage of cases. An "obscure autopsy" is one where findings are minimal or indefinite. Recognised causes include vagal inhibition, certain arrhythmias, anaphylaxis and some poisons.
